title: Functional bag organizers to put in a drawer or on a counter; cannot be hung; all are oversized
text:
Functional bag organizers to put in a drawer or on a counter; cannot be hung; all are oversized. This is a functional plastic bag organizer that comes in four separate compartments with one each for quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. It also comes with 16 plastic nubs to put on the corners on the underside to keep it from slipping around. Since this is not one unit, it cannot be hung on the wall. The nubs keep these from slipping around on the counter or in a drawer. However, the beauty of this design is that each compartment can be configured anyway one desires. They can go in several separate drawers or in an L shape in one drawer, or side-by-side, etc.

I love the way this keeps all my plastic bags in order. However, there is one other negative besides the fact that it cannot be hung. All the holders are oversized compared to other organizers I tried.

Overall, this is a decent organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. I do wish it had a frame for at least three or all the compartments so that it could be hung. I also wish they were not so oversized (on the wide side).

The current price of $31.30 ($32.95 minus 5%) is competitively priced for this. However, I personally feel this [[ASIN:B09D5Y63D1 one]] is better if one is looking for four separate compartments. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. I tried all of these and the style is based on what one desires.
